title: Schedule 1-hour team planning meeting from ICS calendars
query: Find the earliest valid 1-hour meeting slot for Alice, Bob, and Carol during January 15-19, 2024, business hours 9 AM-6 PM Monday-Friday, that satisfies their availability constraints and avoids existing calendar conflicts. Alice prefers 9 AM-12 PM and can do 12-2 PM if needed, but absolutely no meetings after 2 PM or before 9 AM. Bob prefers 1-5 PM, can do 11 AM-1 PM if needed, must leave by 4:30 PM on Tue/Thu, and has no meetings before 10 AM. Carol is available 9 AM-5 PM, unavailable 12:00-12:30 PM for lunch, prefers not to meet on Mondays, and needs a 15-minute buffer after meetings ending at 4:45 PM or later. Read the three input ICS files at /app/alice_calendar.ics, /app/bob_calendar.ics, and /app/carol_calendar.ics without modifying them. Create /app/meeting_scheduled.ics containing a valid ICS file with BEGIN:VCALENDAR and END:VCALENDAR, VERSION:2.0 and PRODID headers, and a VEVENT for a 1-hour Team Planning Meeting including alice@example.com, bob@example.com, and carol@example.com. Use UTC times in YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ format, assume local time is UTC, and evaluate earliest valid slot at minute granularity. Use Carol's Monday avoidance and Alice's morning preference as tie-breakers when multiple valid slots exist; Bob's afternoon preference is informational only.
